events.summary: You know how this story ends. You do not know what it asks for along the way. The free Wretched Tales: Cinderella demo opens on October 8, 2026 at 10:00 AM PDT (October 9, 2:00 AM KST). A hazel branch that needs planting. A dinner the family is waiting for.
